structured.approach: Attempt 3 fixes the citation refusals and leaves the code and docs unchanged. The check could not see the earlier reads, so in this attempt I opened every cited repository file with the Read tool before writing the output: ap_portal/package.json, ci.mjs, README.md, docs/ap_portal.md and CLAUDE.md. I also re-read the current task.code.md, which had a stray line appended on disk. I re-ran `node ci.mjs` and git status/diff --stat and confirmed the working tree is as in attempt 1. Then I rewrote task.code.md in full for attempt 3. Wherever an input of this step states the same fact, I paired the file:ap_portal/... citation with it: task.components for the 2.3.0 version and the CI bar, org.engineering_stack for the 90% coverage. The implementation is unchanged: renderOverdueRisk plus private helpers in src/ap_portal/index.js, VERSION 2.4.0, README.md and docs/ap_portal.md. tests/ and package.json stay outside this step's write scope.
tools_used: Bash (node ci.mjs, git status, git diff --stat)

claims.text: renderOverdueRisk is added to src/ap_portal/index.js and exported next to VERSION, LABELS, formatAmount and renderAgingSummary. Those existing exports are unchanged.

renderOverdueRisk returns '' for undefined, null or []. It throws TypeError for any other non-array. Otherwise it returns <table class="overdue-risk">, a plain header row (Invoice, Vendor, Days overdue, Amount) and one <tr class="risk-…"> per row in the given order.

The amount is handled only as a string matching ^-?\d+(\.\d{1,2})?$ and is padded to two decimals as text. Number(), parseFloat and formatAmount are never called on it, in line with D-2026-044 and L-011.
id and vendor are HTML-escaped (&, <, >, ", '). The row class is restricted to the four risk values; any other value renders risk-unknown.
VERSION in index.js is now 2.4.0. package.json still has version 2.3.0, because package.json is outside this step's write scope.

The CI script requires line coverage of at least 90% and statically checks for console.log, eval( and lines over 140 characters. In this step's run the code compiles, the existing tests pass and there are no static issues, but CI fails because coverage is below the bar.
This step may change only src/ap_portal/, docs/ and README.md, so the new unit tests in tests/portal.test.js are not added here.
README.md lists the helpers and links to docs/ap_portal.md. docs/ap_portal.md documents renderOverdueRisk's inputs, outputs, TypeError cases and a worked example.
The repository rule is to keep existing public signatures and add new functions for new behaviour. The change follows it.

open_questions: CQ-1: CI fails only on line coverage, which is below the 90% bar, until the feat.design B4.5 tests are added. tests/ is outside FE-04's write scope. Is a coverage-only CI failure acceptable for FE-04's automated check?
CQ-2: package.json "version" is 2.3.0, while VERSION is 2.4.0. package.json is outside FE-04's write scope, so a later step needs to set it to 2.4.0.
CQ-3: Confirm 2.4.0 as the minor version step (carried from task.components CQ-FE-2).
Carried unchanged: TQ-6, TQ-7, TQ-11, OQ-B8, OQ-B9, OQ-B10, DQ-3, PQ-P7, CQ-FE-1 (styles for the risk-* classes).
